preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The length of string a is between 1 and 200, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each character in a is a lowercase English letter
preconditions.description: The characters of string a are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: For each test case, output a string b of length n which is a permutation of characters of the string a, and such that 'trygub' is not a subsequence of it.
postconditions.description: The output string b must not contain the subsequence 'trygub' and must be a permutation of the input string a.
